grounded_on.method: read-only source trace of the rendered Solo product on current main; six domain sweeps (Command Center/approvals, PAIGE workspace/chat, Settings/Team/Billing, comms/integrations/CRM, campaigns/social/vibe/analytics, Mind/memory/calendar/work) cross-referenced against docs/binding-ledger/surface-binding-ledger.json

status_definitions.LIVE: owner UI -> tenant-safe authority -> canonical capability seam -> real execution -> readback -> truthful outcome -> receipt/evidence; every leg traced in source on current main
status_definitions.PARTIAL: the journey renders and some legs are real, but at least one required leg is missing, defective, or scoped to a subset of the journey
status_definitions.UNAVAILABLE: no working owner journey exists for this capability on current main (honest placeholders and honest-absence copy included)
status_definitions.NOT_CONNECTED: the connection seam is live code but no per-tenant provider authorization has been completed; nothing renders as connected without proof
status_definitions.PROOF_OWED: code exists but authenticated runtime proof on a real tenant is owed before the capability may be called done; no claim of completion is made
status_definitions.BLOCKED: parked behind another open workstream or an owner-recorded entry gate; not startable in the Solo lane
status_definitions.NOT_APPLICABLE: deliberately out of scope for Solo by owner ruling (recorded in the row)

privacy: no customer-identifying data; no account numbers; no emails; validated by src/__tests__/solo-completion-matrix.test.ts (digit-run, email, and banned-phrase scanners over rows, orphans, and acceptance scenarios)
